newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends firmer on bullish data.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends firmer on bullish data.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL
Jun (3rd pos) 1,258 rgt/tonne Apr (south) 1,295*
Open/Hi/Low 1,250/1,258/1,248 Prev close 1,287.50
Prev settlement 1,245 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Supportive March export data by SGS and Caleb Brett helped prices to close higher, with buying and shortcovering mostly seen from levels above 1,250. Pakistan's plans to abolish regulatory import duty on vegetable oils has no impact. June futures support at 1,250 with resistance at 1,265.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Prices were also higher with interest seen among CPO. Market awaiting Chicago soyoil trend tonight.

"The exports look good and speculative buying and shortcovering emerged at the current levels, particularly above 1,250," a trader said, adding that players also covered their positions on speculation of a bullish USDA crop report.
At the close, June futures contract closed 13 ringgit higher at 1,258 ringgit ($507.36) a tonne after trading in a 10-ringgit range.
"Chartwise, the (June futures) contract is expected to test the 1,260 ringgit and if this is broken, then the next resistance level will be 1,280 ringgit," a chartist said.
"June futures is well supported at 1,250 ringgit."
Traders said news Pakistan plans to abolish regulatory duty on vegetable oil imports had no impact on the market.
"It is not really a factor as the (local) market is in a consolidation stage now and all these are not really going to have a bearing for the moment," said a trader.
Another dealer in Kuala Lumpur said even if the Pakistani move had an impact it would be minimal.
"The cuts they have announced are across the board and only affects vegoils slightly," said the trader.
Among physicals, Apr (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,295 ringgit against bids of 1,292.50 after trading at 1,290 and 1,292.50. Apr (central) saw offers at 1,285 against bids of 1,277.50.
May (south) was offered at 1,290 and bids at 1,282.50 with trades at 1,280 and 1,275. May (central) saw offers at 1,280 against 1,272.50.
Among refined products, Apr RBD palm oil was offered at $547.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, May at $542.50, June at $540 and July/Aug/Sep at $535.
Apr RBD palm olein saw offers at $585, May at $577.50, Jun at $575 and July/Aug/Sep at $570. Apr was traded at $582.50, May at $572.50 and $575, and June at $571 and $572.
Apr RBD palm stearin was offered at $440 and Apr/May palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $295.
